decisions.summary: Tile 64 ft for grass and reed; bamboo tile is the stand's own grid
decisions.why: A tile size is calibration inside FR-001-FR-003; the GM asked for 'a relatively small block' and does not mind the repetition.

decisions.summary: Tile density is the scatter's interior density (74 sq ft per throw for every blade role, 150/360 sq ft for reeds/tint), no rim feather
decisions.why: FR-001/FR-002 'density per area as today's scatter' (base cover.py: one density for every role); FR-005 drops the feathers on the GM's 'I don't mind the issue about edges'.

decisions.summary: Bare ground cut out of the shape by geometry, not left to layering
Bamboo fill stays at the stand's place in the stack
Pasture's cover path stays unclassed, as its blades were
decisions.why: FR-007 forbids only unclassed ink a class did not have before; pasture had none.

decisions.summary: cover_pattern per kind and scale, fixed seed, the scatter's glyph shapes/colors/stroke, seamless wrap, no background
decisions.why: FR-001-FR-003 and the Key Entity 'cover tile'.

decisions.summary: Scrub bare ground = _commons_keep shape at its pads, every marsh, the crescent ponds and the pond
decisions.why: FR-005 'the ground its scatter keeps bare today': base grass_scatter already refused crescent ponds and the pond; no ground the scatter painted is dropped.

decisions.summary: Marsh zone = drawn ground minus its KeepoutGrid shape; _throw, offer_rethrow, throw_again and throw_to_the_view retire; marsh files no scatter frame
decisions.why: FR-002 and FR-005 as written; throw_to_the_view served only the marsh re-throw registry (frame.py at base).

decisions.summary: A clearing swept later is added to every waiting cover's bare ground
decisions.why: US1 scenario 4; the GM's swept-clearing fallback not needed when the ground is never painted.

decisions.summary: flush_covers clips to the view plus OFFMAP_MARGIN; defs then one evenodd path per cover in slots reserved in _header right after the land rect (scrub, pasture, marsh), so no recorded z index shifts
decisions.why: FR-004 'immediately above the land'; the edge case on zones off the map. Reserved slots versus a splice is mechanism, not scope.
FR-008; verified at base 258626e2f that only cover.py and wet.py append blade groups. Pines and crowns stay per FR-006.

decisions.summary: bamboo_stand draws one tiled path in its g; marks stays the seat count; windbreak culms untouched
Scrub hit region from the recorded cover shape; premerged blade path removed; classes on cover paths; modal prose updated
scatter_audit blade/dot/reed families retire; blade/reed tests rewritten against covers; re-throw tests retire; placement_stages watermark; docs and record edited, entry-drift on modals
decisions.why: FR-008 and SC-002/SC-004; tests that enforce the requested covers serve the request.

decisions.summary: Base /tmp/base298 and clone back to back on the five pool hamlets, best of three per stage, file sizes, into measurements.md with dates, methods and loads
